description: Read a conversation's run-time output (**cursor-based and incremental**): see what a running conversation has produced so far without waiting for the turn to end. Typical use: dsh_list(only_running) to find active conversations, then call dsh_read repeatedly, passing back the last cursor, to watch several in turn. The output buffer is **memory-only and bounded** (a ring; the oldest entries are dropped) and disappears when the server or process exits. **Reasoning is not buffered**: live reasoning of the turn currently running is attached only with include_reasoning=true. The cursor is a **revision number**: an entry whose text grew is returned again; match it by `seq` and replace its text (do not append twice).

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.

cursor.description: The cursor returned last time; omit or pass 0 on the first call.

include_reasoning.description: Attach the live reasoning of the current turn. Default false.

name: dsh_read
title: Read live output
